sections.Overview:
Experience the world famous Oktoberfest, year round, with Pinball on Tap! Travel around the festival, visiting over a dozen tents and collecting steins for each.
Thrill at the exciting rides, including the amazing Corkscrew rollercoaster! Enjoy fantastic music, food, and drink to round out the ultimate Oktoberfest adventure.

sections.Frequently Asked Questions:
When was the Oktoberfest pinball machine released? Oktoberfest was released by American Pinball in October 2018. What is Oktoberfest Pinball? Oktoberfest Pinball is a brewery and festival-themed pinball machine from American Pinball that captures the energy and excitement of the world’s most famous beer festival. Players collect steins to advance through the game, explore different festival tents, and experience exciting features like the incredible Corkscrew rollercoaster ramp. Packed with humor, music, and festive gameplay, Oktoberfest Pinball delivers a celebration unlike any other. Is the Oktoberfest pinball still in production? Oktoberfest is not in production anymore.
